Container.Name: PaperCortex
Container.Overview:
AI document intelligence for Paperless-ngx: semantic search, receipt extraction, and one-click DATEV export with a built-in bilingual (DE/EN) web UI. 100% local via Ollama - no cloud, no telemetry. Ships as an MCP server for Claude Code and other agents.
Requirements: a running Paperless-ngx instance and a running Ollama instance (both may live on the same UnRaid box).
IMPORTANT: set "Allowed Hosts" to the hostname/IP you use to open the web UI (e.g. tower.local or your UnRaid IP) - requests from other host names are rejected as a DNS-rebinding defense.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Settings page, system check, DATEV export

Config.Name: MCP (SSE) Port
Config.Description: MCP server endpoint for Claude Code / agents (SSE transport)

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Configuration, caches, search index, and DATEV export files

Config.Name: Paperless URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Paperless-ngx instance

Config.Name: Paperless API Token
Config.Description: Paperless-ngx: profile menu -> My Profile -> API Auth Token

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: Base URL of your Ollama instance

Config.Name: Allowed Hosts
Config.Description: Comma-separated hostnames/IPs allowed to open the web UI, e.g. tower.local or your UnRaid IP. Required for LAN access (DNS-rebinding defense).

Config.Name: Web UI Access Code
Config.Description: Optional access code for the web UI. Strongly recommended when the port is reachable beyond your own machine.

Config.Name: Analysis Model
Config.Description: Ollama model for receipt analysis (ollama pull qwen2.5:14b)

Config.Name: Embedding Model
Config.Description: Ollama model for the semantic search index (ollama pull nomic-embed-text)

Config.Name: Vision Model (optional)
Config.Description: Optional multimodal model for photo receipts with poor OCR, e.g. minicpm-v

Config.Name: Transport
Config.Description: Keep 'http' on UnRaid: serves the MCP endpoint over SSE and keeps the container running

Config.Name: Export Directory
Config.Description: Where generated DATEV files are stored (inside the Data share)
